whatIs.title: What Is Moroccan Black Soap (Beldi Soap)?
whatIs.imageAlt: Moroccan black soap in a bowl with a kessa glove and olives
paragraphs: Moroccan black soap, known locally as sabon beldi and in French as savon noir, is a soft, paste-like soap made by saponifying olive oil and macerated black olives with a natural alkali. The result is a dark brown, gel-textured soap with a mild, natural olive scent.

Unlike a hard bar, Beldi soap is made for the hammam ritual. It is applied to warm, damp skin, left on for five to ten minutes, rinsed off, and followed by exfoliation with a kessa glove. The soap softens the outer layer of skin so the glove can lift away dead cells, leaving the skin smooth and clean. This ritual is the reason black soap is now in demand from spas, wellness centers and natural skincare brands around the world.

sourcing.title: Authentic Sourcing, Traditional Method
sourcing.imageAlt: Traditional Beldi soap ritual with kessa glove and natural olives
paragraphs: Our soap is prepared by cooperative artisans using the traditional method: olive oil and olive paste are slowly cooked with the alkali, then left to rest and cure until the paste reaches the right texture. This slow process is what gives Beldi soap its smooth gel and gentle feel on the skin.

Buying from cooperatives also means your purchase supports rural employment, especially for women in Morocco. We visit our partner workshops regularly and check every lot before it enters our warehouse in Marrakesh.
A lot is not shipped until texture, scent and moisture match the grade you ordered. You receive the batch number, the cooperative it came from, and documents that match that exact lot.

authentic.title: How to Recognize Authentic Moroccan Black Soap
items: Color and texture: dark brown to black, soft and gel-like, never liquid or hard.
Scent: a natural olive smell; heavy perfume can hide poor quality.
Ingredients: olive oil and olives listed first, with no synthetic detergents or artificial colorants.
Foam: real Beldi soap foams very little; heavy foam usually means added surfactants.
Price: offers far below market price often mean diluted soap.
